news.title: CoreWeave turns to customer prepayments, shorter contracts to fund AI growth
news.summary: CoreWeave is increasingly asking customers to pay upfront, borrowing against specific contracts, and even looking to short-term deals that could lead to higher prices, according to the company’s third-quarter earnings.

news.title: OpenAI, Anthropic face new oversight as New York’s AI safety law takes effect

news.title: All 7 Anthropic founders will each cash out about $250M in IPO
news.summary: Each of the seven co-founders plans to sell exactly the same number of shares in the IPO, which would bring each of them about $250 million in cash at the midpoint of the price range while leaving the group in control of the company.
